grammar: n. 大厅；走廊。可数，复数 halls；在学校的大礼堂可说 the school hall。
collocations: school hall; entrance hall; in the hall。
commonMistake: hall 可指大厅或走廊，具体含义看语境；表示在大厅里常说 in the hall。

example.english: Our class is waiting in the school hall.
example.chinese: 我们班正在学校大厅里等候。

application.prompt: The whole school meets in the large room for an assembly. They meet in the ___. A. hall B. drawer
application.solution: A。解析：全校集会的大房间可以叫 school hall。

grammar: n. 建筑物；可数，复数 buildings。由 build + -ing 构成，但 building 本身常作名词。
collocations: a school building; a tall building; an old building。
commonMistake: building 作名词表示“建筑物”；build 是动词“建造”，注意根据句子位置区分词性。

example.english: The library is in the new building.
example.chinese: 图书馆在新教学楼里。

application.prompt: The school has a new ___. It has four floors and many classrooms. A. building B. violin
application.solution: A。解析：有楼层和教室的建筑物是 building。

grammar: prep./adv. 从一边到另一边；在对面。常用 walk/run across + 地点，表示穿过某处。
collocations: across the field; across the road; across from the gym。
commonMistake: across 常作介词，后接名词，如 across the field；cross 是动词，可直接说 cross the field。

example.english: Walk across the field to get to the gym.
example.chinese: 穿过操场就能到体育馆。

application.prompt: The gym is on the other side of the field. Walk ___ the field to get there. A. across B. inside
application.solution: A。解析：从操场一边走到另一边用 across the field。

grammar: n. 田地；运动场。可数，复数 fields；school field 常指学校操场或运动场。
collocations: a football field; school field; play on the field。
commonMistake: 在运动场上活动可说 on the field；不要和 building（建筑物）混淆。

example.english: The students play football on the field after class.
example.chinese: 学生们课后在操场上踢足球。

application.prompt: The school has a large grassy place for football and running. It is a ___. A. field B. office
application.solution: A。解析：用于踢球和跑步的场地是 field。

grammar: n. 体育馆；健身房，是 gymnasium 的常用简称。可数，复数 gyms。
collocations: school gym; in the gym; go to the gym。
commonMistake: gym 是可数名词，单数前通常要有 a、the 或物主限定词；表示去体育馆可说 go to the gym。

example.english: We have basketball practice in the gym today.
example.chinese: 我们今天在体育馆练篮球。

application.prompt: It is raining, so the students have PE inside the school ___. A. gym B. field
application.solution: A。解析：下雨时在室内体育馆上体育课，用 gym。

grammar: n. 办公室；可数，复数 offices。表示在办公室里常说 in the office；at the office 强调人在办公室上班或办事。
collocations: school office; in the office; office staff。
commonMistake: office 是可数名词；单数前通常有 a/the。拼写注意两个 f：office。

example.english: Please leave the form in the school office.
example.chinese: 请把表格留在学校办公室。

application.prompt: The principal is meeting a parent in the school ___. A. office B. field
application.solution: A。解析：校长接待家长通常在学校办公室，office 表示“办公室”。

grammar: adj. 大的；大型的。比较级 larger，最高级 largest；可作定语或表语。
collocations: a large classroom; a large family; a large number of books。
commonMistake: large 的比较级和最高级分别是 larger、largest；注意 large 变比较级时要去掉末尾不发音的 e 再加 -er。

example.english: Our school has a large library.
example.chinese: 我们学校有一座很大的图书馆。

application.prompt: This classroom can hold 60 students. It is quite ___. A. large B. tiny
application.solution: A。解析：能容纳很多学生说明教室很大，large 表示“大型的”。

grammar: adj. 特别的；特殊的。可作定语或表语；副词形式是 specially，表示“专门地”。
collocations: a special day; a special class; something special。
commonMistake: special 是形容词，specially 是副词；something special 中形容词放在不定代词后。

example.english: Today is a special day for our school.
example.chinese: 今天对我们学校来说是特别的一天。

application.prompt: The school is 100 years old today, so this is a ___ day. A. special B. usual
application.solution: A。解析：百年校庆是特别的日子，special 表示“特别的”。

examTags: 阅读·根据语境判断人物或设备特点
grammar: adj. 聪明的；也可表示衣着整洁漂亮的，或用于 smart device（智能设备）。比较级 smarter，最高级 smartest。
collocations: a smart student; a smart idea; a smart phone/device。
commonMistake: smart 可形容人聪明，也可形容衣着整洁或设备智能；根据它修饰的名词和上下文判断词义。

example.english: Our smart board connects to the school computer.
example.chinese: 我们的智能白板可以连接学校电脑。

application.prompt: The new board can connect to the internet and show videos. It is a ___ board. A. smart B. wooden
application.solution: A。解析：能连接网络并播放视频的设备可称 smart board（智能白板）。

examTags: 词汇·复合名词与课堂物品
grammar: n. 白板；可数。现代英语中通常合写为 whiteboard：a whiteboard，复数 whiteboards。
collocations: write on the whiteboard; a whiteboard marker; clean the whiteboard。
commonMistake: 词表写作 white board，英语中通常也合写为 whiteboard；写“在白板上”用 on the whiteboard。

example.english: The teacher writes the new words on the whiteboard.
example.chinese: 老师把新单词写在白板上。

application.prompt: The teacher writes notes for the whole class to see on the ___. A. whiteboard B. locker
application.solution: A。解析：全班都能看到的课堂书写板是 whiteboard（白板）。

examTags: 词汇·形容词与介词搭配
grammar: adj. 重要的。常用 be important to sb.（对某人重要）或 be important for sb. to do（对某人做某事重要）。
collocations: an important person; an important question; important to me。
commonMistake: important 是形容词，前面常用 be；说“对某人很重要”可说 important to sb.。

example.english: It is important to keep the school clean.
example.chinese: 保持学校整洁很重要。

application.prompt: The library helps us learn, so it is ___ to our school. A. important B. empty
application.solution: A。解析：图书馆对学校有重要作用，important 表示“重要的”。

examTags: 阅读·提取公告与细节信息
grammar: n. 通知；告示；v. 注意到。作名词可数，复数 notices；作动词 notice—noticed—noticed。
collocations: read a notice; notice board; notice a change; notice that ...。
commonMistake: notice 可作“通知”或“注意到”；看句子位置区分：read a notice（名词），notice something（动词）。

example.english: I noticed a new notice beside the office door.
example.chinese: 我注意到办公室门旁有一张新通知。

application.prompt: The paper on the wall tells students about a school trip. It is a ___. A. notice B. drawer
application.solution: A。解析：张贴并告知活动安排的文字是 notice（通知）。

examTags: 阅读·根据用途识别地点或物品
grammar: n. 带锁的储物柜；可数，复数 lockers。常见于学校或更衣室。
collocations: a school locker; locker key; put books in a locker。
commonMistake: locker 是储物柜，lock 是锁或“锁上”的动词；locker 通常可用来存放书包和书本。

example.english: I keep my sports shoes in my locker.
example.chinese: 我把运动鞋放在储物柜里。

application.prompt: Students keep their books in a small locked cupboard at school. It is a ___. A. locker B. screen
application.solution: A。解析：学校里带锁的储物柜是 locker。

grammar: n. 抽屉；可数，复数 drawers。常说 a desk drawer 或 in the drawer。
collocations: open a drawer; a desk drawer; put papers in a drawer。
commonMistake: drawer（抽屉）和 draw（画、拉）拼写相近；drawer 末尾有 -er。

example.english: The keys are in the top drawer of the desk.
example.chinese: 钥匙在书桌最上层的抽屉里。

application.prompt: You pull it open to find pens inside a desk. It is a ___. A. drawer B. field
application.solution: A。解析：书桌里可拉开的储物空间是 drawer（抽屉）。

grammar: n. 角；角落。可数，复数 corners。房间里的角落常说 in the corner；街道拐角常说 at the corner。
collocations: in the corner of the room; at the street corner; a quiet corner。
commonMistake: 通常说 in the corner of a room（在房间角落里）；注意不要和 across（穿过）混淆。

example.english: There is a bookcase in the corner of the classroom.
example.chinese: 教室的角落里有一个书架。

application.prompt: The plant is where two walls meet inside the room. It is ___ the corner. A. in B. across
application.solution: A。解析：表示在房间的角落里用 in the corner。

examTags: 词汇·复合名词与教室物品
grammar: n. 书架；可数，复数 bookcases。由 book + case 构成，通常是带层板、用来放书的家具。
collocations: a bookcase full of books; a wooden bookcase; put books on a bookcase。
commonMistake: bookcase 是书架家具；bookshelf 常指书架的一层或书架，二者意思接近，但拼写不要漏掉 bookcase 中的 -case。

example.english: The new bookcase is beside the classroom door.
example.chinese: 新书架在教室门旁边。

application.prompt: Put the novels on the piece of furniture made for holding books. Put them on the ___. A. bookcase B. gym
application.solution: A。解析：用来放书的家具是 bookcase（书架）。

examTags: 词汇·多义名词与校园科技
grammar: n. 屏幕；幕。可数，复数 screens。常指电脑、手机或电视的显示屏。
collocations: a computer screen; a touch screen; look at the screen。
commonMistake: screen 指显示画面的屏幕；不要与 scene（场景）混淆拼写和读音。

example.english: The teacher shows the map on the big screen.
example.chinese: 老师在大屏幕上展示地图。

application.prompt: You can see words and pictures on a computer ___. A. screen B. locker
application.solution: A。解析：电脑显示文字和图片的部分是 screen（屏幕）。

examTags: 词汇·形容词与反义关系
grammar: adj. 现代的；新式的。比较级 more modern，最高级 most modern；常修饰 building、design、technology 等名词。
collocations: a modern school; modern buildings; modern technology。
commonMistake: modern 是形容词，描述建筑或设备；其比较级常用 more modern，不写 moderner。

example.english: Our modern gym has a large screen.
example.chinese: 我们现代化的体育馆里有一块大屏幕。

application.prompt: The school has new computers and smart boards. Its classrooms are ___. A. modern B. ancient
application.solution: A。解析：配有新电脑和智能白板的教室是 modern（现代化的）。

grammar: adj. 令人惊叹的；非常好的。amazing 描述引起惊奇的人或事；amazed 描述感到惊奇的人。
collocations: an amazing school; an amazing view; look amazing。
commonMistake: amazing 形容事物“令人惊叹”；amazed 形容人的感受“感到惊讶”，注意不要混用。

example.english: The science show at our school was amazing.
example.chinese: 我们学校的科学表演令人惊叹。

application.prompt: The school show surprised everyone in a wonderful way. It was ___. A. amazing B. amazed
application.solution: A。解析：show 是令人惊叹的事物，用 amazing；感到惊讶的人用 amazed。

grammar: 规则动词，raise—raised—raised；表示举起、提高时通常是及物动词，后面要接宾语。
collocations: raise your hand；raise a flag；raise money
commonMistake: raise 通常要带宾语，如 raise a hand；rise 表示自身升起或上升，后面通常不直接接宾语。

example.english: We raise the school flag every Monday morning.
example.chinese: 我们每周一早晨升学校的旗。

application.prompt: Please ___ your hand if you have a question. (raise)
application.solution: raise

examTags: 语言运用·校园与国家标志
grammar: 可数名词，表示旗；复数为 flags。
collocations: a national flag；raise a flag；a flagpole
commonMistake: 表示一面旗时用 a flag；复数拼写为 flags。

example.english: A red flag hangs beside the school gate.
example.chinese: 学校大门旁挂着一面红旗。

application.prompt: A piece of cloth with a country's colours or symbol is a ___.
application.solution: flag

examTags: 阅读能力·概括主要信息
grammar: 表示“大多数”时，most 可直接放在名词前；most of 后通常接有限定词或代词的名词短语，如 most of the students。
collocations: most students；most of the class；most of us；the most interesting
commonMistake: 通常说 most students 或 most of the students；不说 most of students。

example.english: Most students in our class walk to school.
example.chinese: 我们班大多数学生步行上学。

application.prompt: ___ students in our class bring a book to reading time. (Most / Much)
application.solution: Most

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: most of or most

grammar: 可作动词，表示改变或更换，过去式和过去分词为 changed；也可作名词，表示变化。
collocations: change seats；change your mind；a big change；change into
commonMistake: 表示“换座位”说 change seats；change 是动词时根据主语和时态变化形式。

example.english: After lunch, we change seats for group work.
example.chinese: 午饭后，我们为小组活动换座位。

application.prompt: Please ___ seats with your partner so you can join a new group. (change)
application.solution: change

grammar: 可数名词，表示座位；复数为 seats。也可作动词，表示使某人就座。
collocations: take a seat；seat number；front seat
commonMistake: 表示“请坐”可说 Please take a seat；seat 指座位，sit 是“坐”这个动作。

example.english: Please take a seat near the window.
example.chinese: 请在窗边坐下。

application.prompt: There is one empty ___ beside the classroom door. (seat / sit)
application.solution: seat

examTags: 语法知识·形容词作表语与定语
grammar: 形容词，表示美味的；可放在名词前作定语，也可放在 be、look 等系动词后作表语。
collocations: delicious food；a delicious lunch；look delicious
commonMistake: delicious 是形容词，可说 The food is delicious；作表语时不要误用副词 deliciously。

example.english: The soup in the school cafeteria is delicious.
example.chinese: 学校食堂里的汤很好喝。

application.prompt: The lunch smells wonderful and tastes very good. It is ___.
application.solution: delicious

examTags: 语法知识·名词性物主代词
阅读能力·判断物品归属
grammar: 名词性物主代词，表示“你的/你们的”，可单独作表语或主语，不直接修饰名词。
collocations: This seat is yours.；Is this book yours?；a friend of yours
commonMistake: 名词前用 your，如 your book；名词省略、单独指“你的”时用 yours。

example.english: This seat is yours, and that one is mine.
example.chinese: 这个座位是你的，那个是我的。

application.prompt: This book belongs to you. It is ___. (your / yours)
application.solution: yours

grammar: 动词，表示发送或寄送；不规则变化为 send—sent—sent。常用 send sth to sb 或 send sb sth。
collocations: send a message；send an email to sb；send sb a photo
commonMistake: 可说 send a note to Amy 或 send Amy a note；不要把 to 放在双宾语结构中。

example.english: I send my cousin a photo of our new library.
example.chinese: 我给表亲发了一张我们新图书馆的照片。

application.prompt: Yesterday, Mia ___ a message to her classmate. (send)
application.solution: sent

examTags: 语法知识·形容词与介词搭配
grammar: 形容词，表示相似的；常用 be similar to，表示与某人或某物相似；也可说 similar in size/colour。
collocations: be similar to；similar in size；a similar idea
commonMistake: 常用搭配是 similar to，而不是 similar with。

example.english: The two classrooms are similar in size.
example.chinese: 这两间教室大小相似。

application.prompt: My new schoolbag is almost the same as yours. It is ___ to yours. (similar)
application.solution: similar

examTags: 语法知识·系动词与形容词
语言运用·表达听闻印象
grammar: 可作名词，表示声音；也可作系动词，表示“听起来”，后接形容词；sound like 后接名词或名词短语。
collocations: a loud sound；sound good；sound interesting；sound like fun
commonMistake: sound 作“听起来”时，后接形容词，如 It sounds interesting；sound like 后接名词短语。

example.english: Your idea for the art club sounds interesting.
example.chinese: 你关于美术社团的想法听起来很有趣。

application.prompt: The new library has art books and a quiet reading room. It ___ great. (sound)
application.solution: sounds

examTags: 语法知识·方位介词短语
阅读能力·理解空间位置
grammar: 可作名词或形容词，表示前面/前部；常见短语有 in front of 和 at the front of。
collocations: in front of the school；at the front of the classroom；front door
commonMistake: in front of 表示在某物前面；at the front of 表示位于某个空间的前部。

example.english: The teacher's desk is at the front of the classroom.
example.chinese: 老师的桌子在教室前面。

application.prompt: The teacher stands at the ___ of the class so everyone can see the board.
application.solution: front

grammar: 表示艺术或美术学科时通常作不可数名词；表示一件具体作品时可说 a work of art。
collocations: art class；art teacher；a work of art；modern art
commonMistake: 表示学科或艺术这一概念时通常不加 a，如 I like art；具体的一件作品可说 a work of art。

example.english: Art is my favourite subject because I like drawing.
example.chinese: 美术是我最喜欢的学科，因为我喜欢画画。

application.prompt: We paint and draw in ___ class. (art / artist)
application.solution: art

examTags: 语法知识·介词与并列结构
grammar: 介词，表示在两者之间；常用结构 between A and B，也可指明确列出的多个对象之间的关系。
collocations: between the library and the art room；between two desks；the difference between A and B
commonMistake: 常用 between A and B；不要写成 between A to B。

example.english: The library is between the art room and the music room.
example.chinese: 图书馆在美术教室和音乐教室之间。

application.prompt: The library is ___ the art room and the music room. (between / behind)
application.solution: between

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与复数
grammar: 可数名词，表示图书馆；复数为 libraries，变复数时把辅音字母加 y 改为 -ies。
collocations: school library；borrow books from the library；library card
commonMistake: library 的复数是 libraries，不是 librarys；borrow 表示借入，常与 from 连用。

example.english: I borrow two storybooks from the school library each week.
example.chinese: 我每周从学校图书馆借两本故事书。

application.prompt: You can borrow books and read quietly in the school ___.
application.solution: library

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与复数
grammar: 可数名词，由 black + board 构成，表示黑板；复数为 blackboards。
collocations: write on the blackboard；clean the blackboard；a piece of chalk
commonMistake: 表示在黑板上写通常用 write on the blackboard；on 表示接触黑板表面。

example.english: Our teacher writes the date on the blackboard with chalk.
example.chinese: 老师用粉笔把日期写在黑板上。

application.prompt: The teacher writes with chalk on the ___.
application.solution: blackboard

examTags: 语法知识·副词与短语动词
grammar: 副词，常与动词构成短语，表示向上或完成某个动作；如 stand up、get up、look up。
collocations: stand up；get up；look up a word；put your hand up
commonMistake: stand up 是常见短语，表示站起来；up 与 stand 一起表达这个动作。

example.english: We stand up when our teacher enters the classroom.
example.chinese: 老师走进教室时我们起立。

application.prompt: The teacher asks everyone to rise from their chairs: Please stand ___.
application.solution: up

examTags: 语法知识·方位与副词短语
阅读能力·理解空间位置
grammar: 可作名词、副词或形容词；表示空间位置时可指后面，常见短语为 at the back of；go/come back 表示回去/回来。
collocations: at the back of the classroom；go back；come back；back door
commonMistake: at the back of the classroom 表示在教室后部；back 也可作副词表示返回，需结合短语判断。

example.english: Two students sit at the back of the classroom.
example.chinese: 两名学生坐在教室后面。

application.prompt: The teacher's desk is near the board, and the door is at the other end. The door is at the ___ of the room.
application.solution: back

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与复数
grammar: 可数名词，表示钟；复数为 clocks。clock 通常指放置或挂置的钟，watch 通常指戴在手腕上的表。
collocations: a wall clock；a clock on the wall；clock face
commonMistake: clock 通常指挂钟或座钟；watch 通常指手表。

example.english: The clock above the blackboard shows nine o'clock.
example.chinese: 黑板上方的钟显示九点。

application.prompt: The object on the classroom wall shows the time. It is a ___.
application.solution: clock

grammar: map 是可数名词，表示“地图”；复数为 maps。常用 a map of... 表示“……的地图”，on the map 表示“在地图上”。
collocations: a map of the school; a world map; look at a map; find a place on the map
commonMistake: map 是可数名词，单数前通常要有 a、the 或其他限定词；常说 a map of our school。

example.english: This map shows the way from my classroom to the library.
example.chinese: 这张地图标出了从我教室到图书馆的路线。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Our classroom plan shows where the rooms are. It is a ___. A. map  B. email
application.solution: A. map。标出房间位置的图是 map（地图）。

grammar: computer 是可数名词，表示“计算机、电脑”；单数前通常用 a，复数为 computers。
collocations: a computer; use a computer; computer screen; computer room
commonMistake: computer 以辅音音素开头，单数前用 a computer，不用 an computer。

example.english: We use the computer to find information for our project.
example.chinese: 我们用电脑为项目查找信息。

application.prompt: 选词填空：We use a ___ to type and save our homework. A. computer  B. window
application.solution: A. computer。打字并保存作业通常使用电脑。

grammar: window 是可数名词，表示“窗户”；复数为 windows。常用 open/close the window 表示开窗/关窗。
collocations: open/close a window; by the window; look out of the window; a classroom window
commonMistake: window 是可数名词；表示多个窗户时用 windows，不能用单数 window。

example.english: Please open the window to let in some fresh air.
example.chinese: 请打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Our classroom has four big ___. A. window  B. windows
application.solution: B. windows。four 后接可数名词复数。

grammar: science 表示“科学”或学校学科“科学”时通常作不可数名词；泛指学科时常说 study/learn science，通常不加 a。
collocations: science class; science teacher; learn science; science and technology
commonMistake: 表示学校学科时通常说 science 或 science class，不说 a science；a science 可用于特指某一门科学领域等语境。

example.english: Science is my favorite subject because I like doing experiments.
example.chinese: 科学是我最喜欢的学科，因为我喜欢做实验。

application.prompt: 选词填空：We learn about plants and animals in ___ class. A. science  B. a science
application.solution: A. science。学科名称作定语时说 science class，不加 a。

grammar: picture 是可数名词，表示“图画、照片、影像”；复数为 pictures。常用 a picture of... 表示“……的一张图/照片”。
collocations: draw a picture; take a picture; a picture of my school; look at the picture
commonMistake: picture 是可数名词，单数前通常要有冠词或限定词；“一张学校的照片/图画”可说 a picture of the school。

example.english: I drew a picture of our school garden.
example.chinese: 我画了一幅我们学校花园的图画。

application.prompt: 选词填空：I drew a ___ of our school on paper. A. picture  B. question
application.solution: A. picture。画在纸上的图画是 picture。

examTags: 语法·be famous for 搭配
grammar: famous 是形容词，表示“著名的”。be famous for 后接出名的事物或原因；be famous as 后接身份或职业。
collocations: be famous for sth; be famous as a writer; a famous school; become famous
commonMistake: 说因某事而出名用 be famous for；说作为某种身份出名用 be famous as。

example.english: Our school is famous for its friendly teachers.
example.chinese: 我们学校因老师们友善而出名。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The city is ___ for its old bridge. A. famous  B. fame
application.solution: A. famous。be 动词后需要形容词 famous；fame 是名词。

grammar: table 是可数名词，常表示“桌子、餐桌”；复数为 tables。at the table 常指坐在桌边用餐或做事，on the table 指在桌面上。
collocations: a table; at the table; on the table; a dining table
commonMistake: 表示物品在桌面上用 on the table；表示坐在桌边用餐或做事常用 at the table。

example.english: The class picture is on the table by the window.
example.chinese: 班级照片在窗边的桌子上。

application.prompt: 选词填空：We eat dinner at the kitchen ___. A. table  B. window
application.solution: A. table。吃饭使用餐桌，at the table 表示在桌边。

grammar: today 可作副词表示“今天”，也可作名词；作时间副词时可放在句首或句末，前面通常不加介词。
collocations: today's lesson; today and tomorrow; do something today; the world today
commonMistake: 表示“今天”通常直接说 today，不说 on today 或 at today；但可说 today's lesson。

example.english: Today we have a computer lesson in the library.
example.chinese: 今天我们在图书馆上电脑课。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Our class has a science test ___. A. today  B. on today
application.solution: A. today。today 作时间副词时前面通常不加介词。

examTags: 词法·可数与不可数用法
语言运用·电子邮件表达
grammar: email 可作名词或动词。表示一封邮件时是可数名词，复数为 emails；表示邮件系统时可作不可数名词；作动词表示“给某人发邮件”。
collocations: send an email; get an email; email address; email sb; reply to an email
commonMistake: 表示一封邮件时用 an email；说“回复邮件”常用 reply to an email，reply 后不要漏掉 to。

example.english: I will send an email to my teacher after class.
example.chinese: 下课后我会给老师发一封电子邮件。

application.prompt: 选词填空：I sent an ___ to my teacher this morning. A. email  B. emails
application.solution: A. email。an 后接单数名词；此处表示一封邮件。

grammar: answer 可作名词“答案、回答”，也可作动词“回答”。动词 answer 可直接接问题或人作宾语；名词常用 the answer to a question。
collocations: answer a question; answer the teacher; the answer to a question; a correct answer
commonMistake: answer 作动词时直接说 answer a question，不加 to；作名词时才常说 the answer to a question。

example.english: Please answer the question in a complete sentence.
example.chinese: 请用完整的句子回答这个问题。

application.prompt: 选词填空：When the teacher asks me a question, I ___ it. A. answer  B. ask
application.solution: A. answer。对问题作出回应是 answer it；ask 表示提出问题。

grammar: question 是可数名词，表示“问题、提问、试题”；复数为 questions。常用 ask a question 和 answer a question。
collocations: ask a question; answer a question; a question about science; question mark
commonMistake: question 是可数名词，单数前通常需要 a、the 或其他限定词；提出问题说 ask a question。

example.english: I have a question about the science homework.
example.chinese: 我有一个关于科学作业的问题。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The teacher wants to know your name, so she asks a ___. A. question  B. answer
application.solution: A. question。询问信息时提出的是 question（问题）。

grammar: exercise 可作名词或动词。表示练习题时是可数名词；表示一般体育锻炼时通常作不可数名词；作动词时表示锻炼。
collocations: do an exercise; Exercise 2; get some exercise; do exercises; exercise regularly
commonMistake: 表示一般体育锻炼常说 get/do some exercise；表示一道练习题时可说 an exercise 或 Exercise 2。

example.english: We do one English exercise before lunch.
example.chinese: 午饭前我们做一道英语练习题。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Please finish the grammar ___ on page 10; it has five sentences to complete. A. exercise  B. computer
application.solution: A. exercise。需要完成的语法练习题是 exercise。

grammar: way 是可数名词，可表示“路线、方法、方式”；常用 the way to a place 表示“去某地的路”，a way to do sth 或 a way of doing sth 表示“做某事的方法”。
collocations: the way to school; a way to do sth; a way of learning; on the way to
commonMistake: 表示“去某地的路”用 the way to + 地点；表示“做某事的方法”可用 a way to do 或 a way of doing。

example.english: This is the way to our school library.
example.chinese: 这是去我们学校图书馆的路。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Our school map shows the ___ from the gate to the music room. A. way  B. subject
application.solution: A. way。表示从校门到音乐教室的路线用 way。

grammar: best 是 good 和 well 的最高级，常表示“最好的、最好地”；最高级前通常用 the。比较三者或以上时可用 the best。
collocations: the best student; the best way; do one's best; best friend
commonMistake: good–better–best 是不规则变化；比较三者或以上常用 the best，不用 better。

example.english: The library is the best place to read at school.
example.chinese: 图书馆是学校里读书最好的地方。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Of the three routes, this one is the ___ way to school. A. best  B. better
application.solution: A. best。of the three 表示三者比较，用最高级 best。

grammar: because 是从属连词，表示“因为”，后接含主语和谓语的句子；because of 是介词短语，后接名词或名词短语。
collocations: because + 从句; because of + 名词; ... because ...
commonMistake: because 后接句子，because of 后接名词或名词短语；不要把 because of 直接放在完整从句前。

example.english: I like science because we learn about the world.
example.chinese: 我喜欢科学，因为我们能了解世界。

application.prompt: 选词填空：We use the computer in class ___ it helps us find information. A. because  B. because of
application.solution: A. because。空格后是完整句子 it helps us find information，因此用 because。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: Because, because of and cos

grammar: why 是疑问副词，常用于询问原因；特殊疑问句中通常用 Why + 助动词/be 动词 + 主语...? 回答原因常用 because 引出。
collocations: Why...?; Why not...?; That's why...; the reason why
commonMistake: why 用来问“为什么”，because 用来说明“因为”；不要用 because 代替 why 提问。

example.english: Why is the classroom so quiet today?
example.chinese: 今天教室里为什么这么安静？

application.prompt: 选词填空：___ do you like science? Because we do fun experiments. A. Why  B. Who
application.solution: A. Why。答句 Because... 给出原因，问句应用 Why。

grammar: dear 可作形容词表示“亲爱的、珍贵的”；在信件或电子邮件开头，Dear + 称呼/姓名是常见的称呼格式，后面通常加逗号。
collocations: Dear Mom; Dear Mr Lee; my dear friend; a dear friend
commonMistake: 邮件或书信开头可写 Dear + 称呼/姓名，后加逗号；Dear 在这里不是“昂贵的”。

example.english: Dear Mr Lee, thank you for your email.
example.chinese: 李老师，感谢您的邮件。

application.prompt: 补全邮件称呼：___ Grandma, Thank you for your message. A. Dear  B. Best
application.solution: A. Dear。邮件开头称呼收件人用 Dear + 称呼。

examTags: 语法·双宾语与动词搭配
grammar: tell 是动词，过去式和过去分词均为 told。常用 tell sb sth、tell sb about sth 或 tell sb to do sth。
collocations: tell me a story; tell sb about sth; tell sb to do sth; tell the truth
commonMistake: tell 的过去式是 told；“告诉某人某事”说 tell sb sth，不能说 tell sth sb。

example.english: Please tell me about your science project.
example.chinese: 请告诉我你的科学项目是关于什么的。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Please tell ___ the way to the library. A. me  B. to me
application.solution: A. me。tell sb sth 结构中，tell 后直接接人称代词宾格 me。

grammar: interesting 是形容词，表示“有趣的、引人注意的”，常描述事物或人带给他人的感受；interested 描述人的感受。
collocations: an interesting book; an interesting lesson; find sth interesting; be interested in sth
commonMistake: interesting 通常描述“令人感兴趣的事物”，interested 描述“感到有兴趣的人”；注意 -ing 和 -ed 的区别。

example.english: The picture of the solar system is interesting.
example.chinese: 这张太阳系图片很有趣。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The science show is ___; it makes all of us want to watch. A. interesting  B. interested
application.solution: A. interesting。科学节目让人想看，说明节目“有趣”，用 interesting；interested 描述人的感受。
